Very happy with Village Vets, this is the fourth pet we’ve had at this practice and no plans to go anywhere else. For our dog, the Pet Health plan is well worth it, especially when she was a puppy.  Their records are electronics so no matter what location you go to they have the info and the Pet Health Plan works in all the locations outside of emergency hours  (I think).  I also love being able to book all my appointments online. The only downside is that parking is scarce

Their scans to see if your dog is pregnant are 188€ with zero discount for having been in their monthly plan for almost a year! I laughed on the phone at this wacky price. Rang another vet, €50 same scan.

Ruth and Sarah have been absolutely amazing help with all of the paperwork required of flying my dog to AUS.
Both girls and all the staff in fact are extremely friendly and helpful!!
Big recommends 🙌🏻
Bernie …

DO NOT BRING YOUR PETS TO VILLAGE VETS !!!
My daughter’s dog died in their care due to a procedure that they chose. Dealing with the loss of her beloved pet was bad enough but Village Vets then decided to chase us for a fee of over €1000.
We disputed this and they have handed this to their debt collectors who continue to pursue us for thus money.

Shame on you !

Ian
Good service

Posting again as my previous reviews appear to have been removed.

My experience with Village Vets was devastating. I told the practice that my dog had a heart murmur and that I was concerned he would not be able to tolerate anaesthetic. Despite my concerns, a procedure was carried out that I did not believe I had consented to, and my dog sadly died while in their care.

Since then, my family and I have received multiple solicitor’s letters demanding payment. In my opinion, this has been a terrible way to treat grieving customers.

My experience with Village Vets was deeply upsetting. In 2023, I brought my dog in for treatment and made it clear that, due to her heart condition, I did not want her to be put under anaesthetic for the procedure. Despite this, she was anaesthetised and sadly passed away, which was an incredibly traumatic experience for me and my family.

As if that wasn’t distressing enough, I subsequently received multiple letters demanding payment for the procedure and threatening legal action. To this day, those threats have continued. Based on my experience, I was extremely dissatisfied with both the care provided and the way I was treated afterwards. I would strongly encourage anyone to avoid this company, it’s a money centered business that does not care for the animals

Thank you so much to the team at Village Vets for giving the most compassionate end-of-life care to our lovely senior cat. A special thank you to Ruth, who was so kind-hearted and sympathetic to us. The team acted so quickly and compassionately when we presented with an emergency, and I can't thank them enough for a dignified end to her long life ❤️
Top class service, from reminder texts about medication, foods or health checks and the service from staff is top class.  Highly recommended

We’ve been bringing our 16-year-old cat, Lucky, to Village Vets Sandyford, and the care has been outstanding.

He recently had mouth surgery (five teeth removed) and needed extra care afterwards. He spent two full days at the clinic for IV fluids, coming home  in the evenings to rest. The vets and nurses were absolutely amazing, so professional, kind and attentive.

We’re also on their plan, which has saved us money. Highly recommend!
Thank you so much for the review, James!

We joined the pet health plan for our cat Bean five years ago when we got him. It has been invaluable. He gets his yearly vaccinations and we bring him monthly for weight check, health check and to get his nails trimmed. He wasn’t too happy to get his nails done recently and ended up just getting back paws done! The vet rang me later to suggest some medicine to calm him, which I collected and returned with Bean the next morning - success! I really appreciated the help they gave me and more importantly, Bean ❤️ thank you so much!

Exceptional care at Village Vet Sandyford. My dog had an unexpected tooth extraction last week, and the entire process was seamless. From the quick diagnosis on Tuesday to the surgery on Thursday, the communication was excellent.
Most importantly, my dog was calm, recovered quickly, and was even wagging her tail when we went back for a check-up! It’s clear she trusts the team here, and so do I. A huge thank you to the wonderful vets and nurses for making a stressful situation so much easier for us
